'''Kelkon Slavir''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] named Kelkon Selavir served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], Selavir was stationed at the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command's]] secret [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Commander Selavir later participated in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], while stationed at the end of one of the base's hallways. Along with [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kenki Spriow]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Scohen Shnaus]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Scodo Simas]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Alebry Slemic]], Selavir was among the defenders [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]] during the course of the battle.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempRebelSnow.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Commander Kelkon Selavir, including a male and female depiction]]
Kelkon Selavir was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
